card.name: Space before a dose amount
card.fires_on: The space (or decimal point) right before a dose number such as 50 mg or 2.5 mg/kg, in dosing tables and regimen lines. It is often after a weight range, a colon, or words like 'administer'.

modes.label: Space before dose number
modes.description: A blank space right after a weight band or colon, just before the dose amount.
